connector.summary: Hosted at intel.twzrd.xyz over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package twzrd-agent-intel. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace xyz.twzrd.intel, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
